summary: Position/lap-change state handler. Takes a new position value a2 and an event kind a3. When a2 differs from the previously stored position (this+0x1EF4), it encodes a change direction into this+0x1EF8 (1 for a2 == -1, +1 when a2 exceeds the counter at this+0x1EF0, -1 when a2 is lower, 0 when a2 == 0), stores the new position, and resets the counter. Lost-position (direction <= 0) and gained-position (direction > 0) branches each copy their reference data into this+0x1E7C/0x1E80 and fire a sound trigger on base ID this+0x1F00 + 20 (different trigger per branch). Depending on a3 (0 = plain change, 4 = with lap) it sets the UI state at this+0x34 (2 lost, 3 gained, 5 lost+lap, 6 gained+lap) and commits UI params this+0x38 = this+0x60 and this+0x3C = this+0x64. Called from Gearbox, VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate and sub_447780.

local_names.this[13]: UI position-change state at this+0x34 (2/3 plain, 5/6 with lap)
local_names.this[14]: UI param A at this+0x38, copied from this+0x60
local_names.this[15]: UI param B at this+0x3C, copied from this+0x64
local_names.this[24]: reference UI value A at this+0x60
local_names.this[25]: reference UI value B at this+0x64
local_names.this[1980]: position tracking counter at this+0x1EF0, reset on change

operations.description: Change detection: if a2 equals this+0x1EF4 (previously stored position) skip the whole update and return unchanged.
Encode direction into this+0x1EF8: a2 == -1 -> 1; a2 nonzero -> 2 * (a2 > this+0x1EF0) - 1 (+1 gained / -1 lost against the tracking counter); a2 == 0 -> 0.
Store the new position: this+0x1EF4 = a2, then reset the tracking counter this+0x1EF0 = 0.
Branch on change direction: if this+0x1EF8 (v5) > 0 take the gained-position branch, otherwise the lost-position branch.
Lost-position reference copy: this+0x1E7C = this+0x1E94 and this+0x1E80 = this+0x1E98.
Lost-position UI state: if a3 == 0 set this+0x34 = 2 (lost, plain); else if a3 == 4 set this+0x34 = 5 (lost + lap).
Gained-position reference copy: this+0x1E7C = this+0x1E84 and this+0x1E80 = this+0x1E88.
Gained-position UI state: if a3 == 0 set this+0x34 = 3 (gained, plain) and return; else if a3 == 4 set this+0x34 = 6 (gained + lap) and return.
Common-tail UI param commit (a3 == 1, or the lost-branch a3 == 4 path after setting state 5): this+0x38 = this+0x60 and this+0x3C = this+0x64.
Return the accumulated result (the last UI value read from this+0x60, or a2 when unchanged).

clean_pseudocode: if a3 == 0: this[0x34] = 2; else if a3 == 4: this[0x34] = 5;
unresolved: The exact semantics of a3 values other than 0 and 4 (e.g. a3 == 1, seen in the VehicleMainPhysicsUpdate caller) are not special-cased in the .c; they only hit the common-tail param commit without changing the UI state.

a2 == -1 encodes direction 1 (gained) in the .c, which reads as an anomaly against the fills' 'direction -1 = lost, +1 = gained' convention; the -1 input likely means a special 'no position / leaving grid' event, but the .c alone does not disambiguate it.
